faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, direct answers about creating, customizing, and downloading invoices online.

items.question: What is an online invoice creator?
items.answer: An online invoice creator is a web-based software program that allows businesses, freelancers, and contractors to generate professional billing documents directly in their browser. Using our fast online invoice tool, you can input line items, calculate sales tax, apply discounts, and generate polished invoices instantly without installing desktop software. Everything processes immediately inside your browser.

items.question: Is there a free online invoice generator with no sign-up?
items.answer: Yes, Online Invoice Creator is a completely free online invoice generator with no sign-up or registration required. You can start creating your invoice immediately upon opening the page, customize line items, calculate totals, and download your finished document without submitting an email address, entering a password, or providing credit card information. Your billing workflow remains private and instant.

items.question: How do I create an invoice online for free?
items.answer: You can create an invoice online for free in four simple steps using our interactive builder. First, enter your business details and client contact information. Next, add your itemized products or billable hours with unit prices. Then, choose your preferred currency, sales tax, and discount rate. Finally, click download to create invoice free drafts as clean, high-resolution PDF files ready to email.

items.question: What should an invoice include?
items.answer: A complete commercial invoice should include clear identification for both parties, transaction dates, and an itemized breakdown of costs. Specifically, make sure to list your business name, client details, a unique invoice number, issue date, payment due date, item descriptions with quantities and rates, subtotal, applicable taxes, and total due. You should also add explicit payment instructions and bank details.

items.question: Can I add my logo to a free invoice?
items.answer: Yes, you can upload and display your custom company logo on any invoice at no cost. Simply click the logo upload box at the top of the invoice editor and select your PNG, JPG, or SVG image file. The system formats and sharpens your graphic client-side, embedding it directly into your printable invoice without adding third-party watermarks.

items.question: Can I download my invoice as a PDF?
items.answer: Yes, you can download your invoice as a vector-sharp PDF document with a single click. Our client-side pdf invoice generator produces standard A4 and US Letter formats optimized for printing and digital emailing. You can also print physical copies directly or export your invoice data as JSON for secure offline backups on your own hard drive.

items.question: Is there an invoice generator app for my phone?
items.answer: While we do not operate a native app store download, our platform works seamlessly as an invoice generator app directly inside any mobile browser. You can open the website on your iPhone, iPad, or Android device, fill in client charges, preview the layout, and save crisp PDF invoices on the go without installing separate software packages or consuming storage space.

items.question: Is this invoice generator good for small business?
items.answer: Yes, our tool is specifically engineered as an efficient invoice generator for small business owners who need quick, professional invoicing without ongoing subscription overhead. It accommodates multi-currency invoicing, custom sales tax rates, line-item discounts, and company logos. Small businesses can send professional, unbranded invoices to clients immediately while maintaining total control over their billing records without vendor lock-in.

items.question: How do I create an invoice for freelance work?
items.answer: To create an invoice for freelance work, document your project milestones or hourly rates, add client details, and itemize completed deliverables. For specialized freelancer workflows including retainer billing and hourly tracking, explore our dedicated freelancers page. You can enter project descriptions, specify payment terms, and download polished PDFs to ensure prompt client payment.

items.question: Can I make an invoice in Excel or Word?
items.answer: Yes, you can build invoices using spreadsheet or word processing software, although manual templates frequently suffer from broken formatting and calculation errors. For a more reliable automated alternative with instant PDF generation, visit our invoice generator excel page. Our browser tool computes taxes and totals automatically without manual spreadsheet formulas or cell alignment headaches.

items.question: What is the difference between an invoice and a receipt?
items.answer: An invoice is a formal payment request issued before receiving payment, whereas a receipt is proof of payment issued after funds have been settled. Invoices establish payment terms, due dates, and owed balances for completed deliverables. Once your customer pays their bill in full, use our free online receipt generator to provide official documentation confirming receipt of funds for accounting records.

items.question: Is an invoice made here legally valid?
items.answer: Invoices created here contain all standard fields required by commercial jurisdictions worldwide, making them suitable for business billing and tax accounting. However, specific tax rules vary by region, so please check local regulations such as ABN and GST in Australia or VAT obligations via GOV.UK invoicing rules to confirm your jurisdiction's mandatory disclosures.

items.question: Do you store my invoice data?
items.answer: No, we do not store, view, or transmit any of your invoice data or customer information. Nothing is uploaded to external servers; every calculation, company logo, and line item stays strictly on your local device. Your private business records and financial figures remain stored exclusively within your own browser, ensuring total privacy and data confidentiality.
